responsibility: Implements the rs6000 RTL pass that analyzes little-endian pre-Power9 VSX code on Power8-class targets to eliminate unnecessary doubleword swap instructions. It builds webs of swap-related vector computations, identifies loads, stores, constants, and special swappable operations whose semantics are unaffected by reversed doubleword order, then rewrites swap sequences into copies or adjusted load/store forms, reducing the overhead of emulating element endianness in VSX memory operations.
